collection.noMatches: Nothing here matches these filters. Clear the filters to see everything again.

errors.unexpected: That did not save because of a problem on our side. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact support.
errors.notFound: That item is gone or you no longer have access to it. Refresh the page to see the current list.
errors.conflict: That value is already taken in this organization. Choose another one.
errors.invalid: Some of what you entered is not valid.
errors.refused: The database refused that change. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.fileTooLarge: That file is larger than 50 MB. Upload a smaller file.
errors.scanning: That file is still being scanned for viruses. Try the download again in a minute.
errors.asset_class_in_use: This class still has units or lots. Move or archive them before you archive the class.
errors.asset_lot_count_negative: A count is zero or more. Enter the quantity you counted.
errors.asset_lot_insufficient: There is not that much on hand in this lot. Check the quantity and try again.
errors.asset_lot_quantity_ledger: A lot quantity changes through a count or a check-out, not an edit. Record a count instead.
errors.asset_state_conflict: Someone moved this asset a moment ago. Refresh the page to see its current state.
errors.asset_tag_immutable: An asset keeps its tag. Register a new unit if the tag must change.
errors.asset_transition_not_allowed: An asset cannot make that move from its current state. Choose one of the moves offered.
errors.cross_org_reference: That choice belongs to another organization. Choose one from this organization.
errors.enumeration_domain: That condition is not in the canon Asset Condition list. Choose one of the conditions offered.
errors.transition_reason_required: Every state change carries a reason. Say why the asset moves.
errors.asset_code_unknown: No asset or lot in this organization carries that code. Check the label and scan again.
errors.asset_code_ambiguous: More than one asset carries that identifier, so it cannot be told apart. Scan the asset tag instead.
errors.asset_scan_custodian_required: Choose the one member or engagement that takes it.
errors.asset_scan_lot_transfer: A lot quantity is not passed hand to hand. Check it in, then out to the next person.
errors.asset_scan_place_required: This asset has no home venue. Choose the place it comes back to.
errors.asset_scan_quantity_required: Enter how many of the lot move.
errors.asset_scan_state_conflict: Someone moved this asset since you looked it up. Look it up again to see where it is now.
errors.asset_scan_unavailable: This asset is not in service, so it cannot be checked out or in. Move it back to Available first.
errors.asset_scan_event_reused: That scan was already used for another item. Close this window and scan again.
errors.asset_scan_engagement_closed: That engagement is Complete or Canceled. Gear goes to an engagement that is still open.
errors.asset_scan_engagement_project: That engagement belongs to another project. Choose its project, or keep the current one.

load.title: Assets did not load
load.sentence: We could not read this page just now. Try again; if it keeps failing, contact support with the reference below.

collab.noComments: No comments yet. Add context the next person will need.
collab.noAttachments: No files yet. Upload photos, manuals or service records.

classes.counts: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} · {lots, plural, one {# lot} other {# lots}}
classes.empty: No asset classes yet. Define the kinds of gear you own, each bound to its canon element.
classes.emptyReadOnly: No asset classes yet. Browse the canon elements while an asset manager sets them up.
classes.notFound: No asset class matches that link. It may have been archived; pick one from the list.
classes.noUnits: No units of this class yet. Register one from Units.
classes.noLots: No lots of this class yet. Count one from Lots.

create.title: New asset class
create.description: Find the canon element this gear is, then name it the way your crew does.
create.searchHelp: Search by item name or element ID, for example moving head or 5000.02.
create.noElements: No canon element matches. Try a shorter word.
create.nameHelp: The name your crew uses, such as Spot Fixture.

archive.title: Archive {name}
archive.description: The class leaves the catalog. It has no units or lots, so nothing else changes.

units.empty: No units yet. Register each serialized piece of gear to track who holds it.
units.emptyReadOnly: No units yet. Check the custody ledger for gear moves once units are registered.
units.emptyNoClasses: Register units after you define an asset class for them.
units.notFound: No unit carries the tag {tag}. It may have been retired from the register; search the list.

none.custody: This unit has not changed hands yet. Check it out to start its custody record.
none.maintenance: No maintenance recorded. Record service when it is done.
none.damage: No damage reported. Report damage as soon as it comes back hurt.
none.identifiers: No serial or GTIN recorded. Add the manufacturer's serial so a scan finds this unit.

create.title: Register unit
create.description: The unit starts Proposed. Move it to Received, then Available, as it arrives.
create.tagHelp: Letters, digits and hyphens, as printed on the label, for example NWL-RAD-014.

transition.title: Change the state of {tag}
transition.description: It is {state} now. Only the moves the asset lifecycle allows are offered.
transition.reasonHelp: Say why, for example Back from the shop or Written off after the storm.

identifiers.title: Add identifier
identifiers.description: Record a value the manufacturer or another authority issued, exactly as printed.
identifiers.schemeHelp: Lowercase, such as serial, gtin14 or mpn.

lots.empty: No lots yet. Count bulk gear you track by quantity, such as cable or sandbags.
lots.emptyReadOnly: No lots yet. Check the custody ledger for gear moves meanwhile.
lots.emptyNoClasses: Count lots after you define an asset class for them.
lots.emptyNoVenues: A lot sits at a venue. Add a venue first.
lots.notFound: No lot matches that link. It may have been archived; pick one from the list.
lots.noMovements: Nothing has moved yet. Check a quantity out or record a count.

create.title: New lot
create.description: Count what is on the shelf now. Later changes are counts and check-outs in the lot ledger.

count.title: Record a count
count.description: The ledger shows {onHand} on hand. Enter what you counted; the difference is recorded.

custody.empty: No custody moves yet. Scan or type an asset tag above to check gear out.
custody.emptyReadOnly: No custody moves yet. Gear moves appear here as they happen.
custody.notFound: No custody entry matches that link. Pick one from the ledger.
custody.projectHelp: The project the gear is out for, if any.

desk.title: Scan or type a code
desk.code: Asset tag, serial or lot label
desk.help: A handheld scanner types the code and presses Enter for you.
desk.cannotMove: It is not in service, so it cannot be checked out or in from here. Open the unit to change its state.

checkOut.title: Check out {code}
checkOut.description: Hand it to a member. It moves to Deployed.

checkIn.title: Check in {code}
checkIn.description: Bring it back to a place. It moves to Available.
checkIn.venueHelp: Leave as is to return it to its home venue.

transfer.title: Transfer {code}
transfer.description: Pass it from the current holder to another member. It stays Deployed.

maintenance.empty: No maintenance recorded yet. Record service as it is done so the history follows the gear.
maintenance.emptyReadOnly: No maintenance recorded yet. Service records appear here as they are added.
maintenance.emptyNoUnits: Record maintenance once units are registered.
maintenance.notFound: No maintenance record matches that link. Pick one from the list.

create.title: Record maintenance
create.description: Say what was done and when. Leave the cost blank when you do not know it yet.
create.costHelp: Leave blank when unknown. A blank cost stays unknown, never zero.

damage.empty: No damage reported. Report damage as soon as gear comes back hurt.
damage.emptyReadOnly: No damage reported. Reports appear here as they are filed.
damage.emptyNoUnits: Report damage once units are registered.
damage.notFound: No damage report matches that link. Pick one from the list.
damage.openUnit: Open {tag} to repair or write it off

create.title: Report damage
create.description: Describe what happened and when. Move the unit to Damaged from its page if it is out of service.
create.descriptionHelp: What is broken and how it happened.

project.empty: No gear is checked out to {project} yet. Check units out to this project from the custody ledger.
